g.text: Leave blank to use the git on PATH
Both are needed before circuitRF starts keeping a history. Nothing is recorded until they are filled in.
Keep a history of my workspaces
Turning this off stops circuitRF recording anything, in every workspace. It deletes nothing: the restore points already taken stay
listed and can still be restored, and turning it back on carries on where each workspace left off.
Keep a history of this workspace
No workspace is open, so there is nothing for this to apply to. Open a workspace and this row will name it.
After 30 days, automatic restore points are thinned and the states they held are no longer offered.
The newest 20 are always kept whatever their age, and changes you recorded yourself are never
